text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as we finished our business with Sounds of Earth and were about to head home...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap)
choice_data_list: Ah, my shoelace is...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Lo sapevo... Shall we head to the shoe store?
We still have time before curfew, after all.
choice_data_list: I can go by myself, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What an elegant person!
I see, so you intend to walk alongside any girl,
no matter how difficult she might be?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What an elegant person!
I see, so you intend to walk alongside any girl,
no matter how difficult she might be?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"However... you mustn't mistake self-sacrifice for love, Direttore.
I fear for your well-being."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"However... you mustn't mistake self-sacrifice for love, Direttrice.
I fear for your well-being."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth leans in so close I can feel her breath, peering into my face.
Taken aback by the proximity, I reflexively turn my head away.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's decided.
As your scorta, I will accompany you no matter what.
Take my hand so you don't trip.

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting!
I brought a few pairs of sneakers in the size you requested.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!
Now then, let us try them in order!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush.
If it means finding the ultimate pair, I am prepared to dedicate this entire evening to the search……!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah...
Y-yeah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why is she so passionate about this?
Speaking of which, when a shoelace snaps, they say...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Certo!
It's just like a snapped shoelace.
Once you re-string it, it'll sing again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of when a violin string snapped.
I admired how she routinely handled the delicate care
and effort required for such a sensitive instrument.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm worried about your well-being"—she said that earlier.
Could she be...
choice_data_list: (Is she planning to take care of me?)
(Are you planning on taking care of me?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To think a Trainer would make their trainee worry about them. Feeling pathetic, I quickly tried on the shoes that were prepared...
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll go with this one.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hold on.
There's a faint dissonance.
Does the instep not fit right?
choice_data_list: As long as we tie the string nice and tight, it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mamma mia!
Turning down the volume doesn't get rid of the noise!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Shower yourself with more love!
For you are a wonderful person, shining just like the sun!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, signorina!
I have a favor to ask—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, a towering pile of shoeboxes had formed,
almost reaching all the way to the ceiling...
choice_data_list: You're going to try all of them!?
You're going to try all of them!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Certo!
There's definitely a pair out there that will make you Cenerentola!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth is dead serious. She intends to discern... or rather, "listen" out for the shoes that truly fit her feet!
choice_data_list: (I have no choice but to do it!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I feel a slight interference.
Is your ankle hitting against something?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No noise, yet devoid of joy.
Seems she isn't fond of the design.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A fantastico chord!
However, that is not the sound that plays you!
Next! Try the next one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She kept trying on more shoes after that,
but none seemed to be the one.
Before we knew it, we were down to the very last pair...
choice_data_list: (Put on the shoes.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A snug fit that completely hugs the entire foot,
and shifting weight feels as smooth as if being pushed from behind.
This thrilling sensation with every step is...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene!! That's it! You understand too, don't you?!
choice_data_list: I get it! That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I have been waiting for you, Cenerentola!
Now, it is time for the ball!
Let me hear the melody of your running!!
choice_data_list: Are you going to run just like that?!
Are you going to run just like that?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! The gates are open...!
Let your music resonate across the sunset sky!
choice_data_list: I-I'll go pay the bill real quick!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Fantastico!
It is brimming with joy and excitement!
Let us speed it up a little! Towards the grand finale!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cenerentola!
What a brilliant sound you resonate!
choice_data_list: I'm glad we had such a great session!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The ultimate session—that is her reason for running.
However, to make it reality, the Trainer must also be
at their absolute best. I need to change my mindset."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Meraviglioso!!
Next time, run with me.
Bis... encore!
choice_data_list: You're gonna run again!?
You're running again!?
Maybe I'm a little tired...
I might be a bit tired...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brava! Meraviglioso!!
Next time, run with me.
Bis... encore!
choice_data_list: You're gonna run again!?
You're running again!?
Maybe I'm a little tired...
I might be a bit tired...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Rest easy.
A moderate tempo, and the baton is in your hands.
Let us go forth freely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, take my hand.
Let me feel your heartbeat.
I want us to play a benissimo chord together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a racing heart, I take the hand and start running.
Perhaps because the shoes fit so well,
running has become mysteriously fun.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for choosing such good shoes—
I'm sure you can already tell by the "sound,"
but I'll put it into words once our session is over.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops... forgive me!
Even after the clock struck midnight, your music
was so beautiful that I just got greedy!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You must be tired from dancing, Cenerentola.
Let us go to that quiet café over there.
Rest your feet to your heart's content.
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when she gets completely absorbed in something,
she never forgets to be considerate of those around her.
Her kindness warmed my heart.
